scope: One synthetic CPU-only Python workload on the lab's pinned Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind node/containerd: red baseline runs as root with a writable root filesystem and RuntimeDefault; green runs as UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem, dropped capabilities, no privilege escalation, and a case-owned Localhost seccomp profile that returns EPERM only for uname. The fixture confirms getpid and an emptyDir scratch write remain permitted. The admission counterfactual distinguishes Restricted PSA and exact regular-container policy. GPU ioctl, shared GPU memory, RDMA verbs, hardware integration, production profile discovery, and provider/runtime variants are not exercised.

checks.claim: RuntimeDefault baseline permits uname and root filesystem writes
checks.observed: uid=0 seccomp=2 uname=allowed getpid=allowed root_write=allowed scratch_write=ok
